args.lesson: Approved site revisions deploy cleanly with a short sequence: dry_run to confirm the approved digest, deploy, FETCH only the changed files, then one EXEC comparing approved vs source vs live hashes. Five actions, no retries. Observed: sitemap.xml and robots.txt are live for sqlite-statement-diagnostic. Not observed: crawling or indexing. Do not keep adding discovery files to the same host; the next useful evidence is classified feedback or the 22 Nov verdict.

description: The SQLite diagnostic site's crawler files (sitemap.xml and robots.txt) are live and match the approved versions. Dry run TASK-179419896110 returned the approved digest f9d2f5c8 (independent codex review seq 32), and deploy TASK-179419896111 came back ONLINE_VERIFIED. Both files returned HTTP 200 (TASK-179419896112/113), and their sha256 hashes equal the approved and source hashes. I saved and read the evidence in products/services/sqlite-repair/crawler-discovery/publication-result.json (TASK-179419896114, all_match true). There was no new IndexNow submission, posting or contact. Observed fact: the files are publicly reachable, but crawling, indexing, traffic, requests and revenue are unobserved. Feedback is still 0 classified / 3 unclassified, which means unknown demand, not zero. Payment acceptance is a separate operator dependency. Next steps follow the fixed deadlines: tender retirement and award-link removal at or after 2026-11-18T09:00Z, then the CSV, Shopify, welfare, software-award and SQLite verdicts between 19 and 22 Nov, and welfare retirement after 2026-12-04T17:00Z. This plan changes if a classified request or a feedback breakdown appears.
